# An app that starts after its Neural Link socket opens never announces its window

## Context

The cloud cold walk for neomjs/neo#20114 (2026-10-26, a fresh container, `npx neo-app@13.3.2`, the published `neo-neural-link@1.0.0`) loaded the app twice with the Bridge already running. Both times `healthcheck` and `get_window_topology` listed no windows, so `simulate_event`, which needs a `windowId`, could only be routed by copying an id out of `query_component`'s output. Connections made *after* the app started (a focus retry, a reconnect after the Bridge was killed) did register the window.

## The Problem

This is the normal agent flow: the harness starts the Neural Link first, then the dev server and page. With the Bridge already up, the socket opens about 0.5 s into the load, before `Neo.app()` has registered the application, and the window is never announced afterwards.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/ai/Client.mjs` `onSocketOpen` (`:304-356`) announces windows once, at open time: from `WindowManager.items`, and for a non-SharedWorker app from the `Neo.apps` registry (`:347-356`).
- `onAppWorkerWindowConnect` (`:217`) runs only for SharedWorker `connect` events.
- `src/controller/Application.mjs:82` registers `Neo.apps[me.windowId] = me` later, and nothing notifies the client. A grep of `src` finds only those three `window_connected` sends.

## The Fix

When a non-SharedWorker application registers while the Neural Link socket is open, announce its window once (`appName`, `windowId`), through the same `window_connected` notification `onSocketOpen` sends. Keep the open-time rehydration for windows that already exist, and never announce a `windowId` twice.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: with the socket opened before the app registers, exactly one `window_connected` carrying the app's `appName` and `windowId` is sent once the app registers (unit, red-first on `dev`).
- [ ] AC-2: an app that exists at open time is announced once, not twice.
- [ ] AC-3 (post-merge, installed): after an ordinary load with the Bridge already running, `get_window_topology` lists the window and `simulate_event` routes with that `windowId`.

## Out of Scope

- The client's deliberate stop after five reconnect attempts (`onSocketReconnectFailed` / `redial`, "never on a timer"). That trade-off is documented for agents in the create-app and skills leaves of #20114.
